info.title: Blauarbeit Partner API
info.description:
Partner integration API for Blauarbeit. Lets approved partners submit
leads (jobs) on behalf of households, list chats and messages tied to
those leads, issue one-time login URLs into the Blauarbeit dashboard,
and look up reference data (country codes, geo/zipcode IDs).

## Authentication
All `/v2/partners/*` endpoints require a Bearer token issued by
`POST /oauth/token` using the `client_credentials` grant. Obtain
`client_id` / `client_secret` from your Blauarbeit contact.

## Environments
- Production: `https://api-prod.blauarbeit.de`
- Staging: `https://api-stag.blauarbeit.de`

post.description:
Submit a new lead (job) on behalf of a household.

### Field rules

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| `title` | required, string, min 5 chars. Auto-generated from `description` (max 40 chars) if omitted. |
| `description` | required, string, min 5 chars. |
| `services` | optional, array of category service IDs (integers). |
| `geo` | required, integer, must exist in `/v2/partners/zipcodes`. |
| `startDate` | required, format `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `endDate` | required, format `YYYY-MM-DD`, must be `>= startDate`. |
| `certified` | optional, boolean. Defaults to `true` (only certified craftsmen). |
| `user.email` | required, valid email. |
| `user.salutation` | optional, integer 1-3 (1 = Herr, 2 = Frau, 3 = Divers). |
| `user.firstName` / `user.lastName` / `user.street` | optional, max 60 chars. |
| `user.door` | optional, max 12 chars. |
| `user.zipcode` | optional, integer geo ID (same source as `geo`). |
| `user.birthDate` | optional, must be > 18 years ago. |
| `user.phoneNumber` / `user.phoneNumberAlternative` | optional, string. |
| `user.countryCode` / `user.countryCodeAlternative` | optional, integer ID from `/v2/partners/country_codes`. |
| `customFields` | optional, max 5 entries. Each: `name` (≤50 chars), `value` (≤191 chars). |

Country code IDs used in `user.countryCode` when submitting leads.

Geo IDs used in `geo` and `user.zipcode` when submitting leads.
The `zipcode` query parameter narrows the result to entries matching
a specific German postal code.

post.description:
Returns a one-time URL that signs the end user into the Blauarbeit
dashboard. The URL has `target=dashboard` and a short-lived `sid`
(≈2 min). When `leadId` is provided, `jobId=<leadId>` is appended so
the dashboard deep-links to that lead.

get.description:
List up to 3 craftsmen near a location, ordered by distance. Filter by
`zipcode` (required) and optionally narrow by `category` or by explicit
`lat` / `lng` coordinates. Rate limited to 30 requests per minute.

Requires the `read-craftsmen` auth scope.

parameters.name: zipcode
parameters.description: German zipcode to search around (5 digits, leading zeros allowed).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional category ID to filter craftsmen by trade.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Optional latitude. Use with `lng` to search around explicit coordinates instead of the zipcode centroid.

partnerOAuth.description:
OAuth2 client credentials grant. Exchange `client_id` /
`client_secret` at `POST /oauth/token` for a Bearer token, then send
it as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on every
`/v2/partners/*` call.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated client is not allowed to perform this action.

scope.description: Optional space-delimited list of scopes to request.

title.description: Lead title. Auto-generated from `description` (max 40 chars) if omitted.

certified.description: Restrict to certified craftsmen. Defaults to `true`.

email.description: Optional. Email of the user being authenticated.

leadId.description: Optional. When supplied, the dashboard deep-links to this lead via `jobId=<leadId>`.

categories.description: Trade categories the craftsman is registered for.

distanceKm.description: Distance from the search location in kilometres.
